title: bug: the per-task reopen cap override `task.maxReopens` is documented (SCHEMA.md:495/:1118, MCP_SERVER.md:2405, qa_reject's tool description) and read (qaReject.ts:221-223), but nothing can ever write it: no MCP tool takes it, no IDE client sets it, and 0 of 1062 live task files carry it, so the docs promise a knob no one can turn
definitionOfDone: After the change, the code and every doc agree. Either nothing documents a per-task maxReopens override, or the override is settable through a validated tool input with tests. With option (c), every doc that names it says no tool sets it.

qa_reject's reply still returns the effective cap as `maxReopens`, and the existing reopen-cap behaviour still holds with fresh vitest results: the soft-cap re-plan at 3, then the hard-cap park with needsHumanReview at 4, and the repeated-DoD-item flip.

The vitest files that reference maxReopens (qaReject, governanceFeatures, lifecycle e2e, parkedReview.guard, qaVerdictHandoff, taskTimeBudgetDocs) pass, and the summary names the option chosen and why.
